summary:
quality lens over statement-model (24 product path(s), 3d57c3c..cc92c65, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 1 non-blocking. VERDICT t-sm-c1: implemented — backend/drizzle-warehouse/0003_statement_leaf_projection.sql:5 defines the structural per-batch outline and backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts:82 writes it transactionally.
VERDICT t-sm-c2: partial — backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.ts:114 scopes duplicate-triple detection to one selection rather than the whole master.
VERDICT t-sm-c3: implemented — backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:160 routes the governed builder to the leaf/month projection using injected leaf targets.
LEFTOVERS: none found.
The projection and snapshot are substantially implemented, but the mapping loader does not guarantee globally unique triple targets and the expanded row guard undercounts the per-period snapshot writes.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Enforce triple uniqueness across the entire mapping master (backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.ts:114): `entryKeys` is recreated for each selection, so the loader only rejects duplicate `(cost_center, gl_code)` entries within one selection.

t-sm-c2: The Mapping Master records a TAGGED target for every entry - either a workbook leaf key or the reserved unmapped-GL bucket of decision 0018 - as provisional entries with reasons, so a SAP (cost centre, GL) triple resolves to exactly one target, recorded rather than inferred; the loader rejects two entries claiming one triple for different targets; and budget ingest validates the candidate snapshot's leaf keys against the master's declared targets so a renamed or renumbered line is reported as drift rather than silently splitting one statement line in two.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Count each per-period outline snapshot against the expanded row cap (backend/src/ingest/mis-budget.parser.ts:196): The limit calculation counts `outlineCount` only once, but `IngestService` passes the complete outline to `replaceBudgetBatch` for every parsed period, causing every outline node to be persisted once per period.

contract_verdicts.evidence: backend/drizzle-warehouse/0003_statement_leaf_projection.sql:5 defines the structural per-batch outline and backend/src/warehouse/ingestion.repository.ts:82 writes it transactionally.
backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.ts:114 scopes duplicate-triple detection to one selection rather than the whole master.
backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:160 routes the governed builder to the leaf/month projection using injected leaf targets.

finding.summary: [P1] Reject mapping drift before persisting the renamed outline (backend/src/ingest/mis-budget.parser.ts:169): The parser calculates missing master leaf keys but merely returns them in `validationResult`; it does not add a validation issue or throw.

rejected_findings.reason: Contradicts accepted decision 0023: the drift check REPORTS and the upload SUCCEEDS. Refusing the batch was put to the human as an explicit option and rejected, because a renamed line would block the client's upload entirely and only we could unblock it. Ingest is deliberately fail-open on drift and fail-closed on money.
